steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the event type to Auction for the reverse auction flow.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 while leaving Delivery location empty.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify that the automatic title is not generated while the required location is empty.
Add one available QA vendor participant, as required before publishing.
Commit the default Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Attempt Publish Event and assert that publishing is refused because the delivery location is missing.
Verify that the refusal identifies Delivery location as required.
